lines: Yes! Did you see that? I hit the thing square in the chest!
Okay, my hands won't stop shaking. Give me a sec.
That was too close. My heart is trying to climb out of my chest.
Hah, I got it! Maybe I got lucky, but I'll take it.
Stunned it good. Your turn, go hit the next one!
Come on, you've got this. Swing big and don't look scared.
I'm so shaky right now, but that thing's down. Let's go!
Nice hit! You're a menace with that crowbar, you know that?
Almost lost my grip there. Remind me to stop sweating so much.
Ha! Did you hear it yelp? Best sound I've heard all night.
I swung and missed, then it nearly grabbed my hair. Yikes.
Missed by like an inch. My nerves are shot, honestly.
Hold on, I need one second. My arm feels like jelly.
Okay, that zap worked. I'm proud of me, don't tell anyone.
It's still twitching. Don't get cocky, we're not done yet.
Zap it once more, then back off. Nice and easy, friend.
Keep swinging like that and you'll be the hero of this floor.
Nah, I'm fine. Only my pride got hurt, and maybe my elbow.
I'm bragging a little, but that was a really good swing.
You're doing great, seriously. Keep your feet under you.
Ugh, the taser's almost dead. I'm not begging it to work again.
My knees are knocking so hard. Somebody hold my hand, please?
That one hit like a truck. I'm feeling pretty tough right now.
Did we just win that? Feels like we got lucky, honestly.
I'll admit it, I screamed a little when that thing lunged.
You nearly knocked its whole head off, wow. Nice work!
Okay, deep breath. I think it's really down this time.
Crowbar's heavy as heck, but I'm swinging it like I own it.
Right on the knee! Hear that crack? That's a win.
Haha, I zapped the thing and my hair stood straight up.
Taser's out of juice. Good news, I still have the axe!
That axe bit deep. My hands are still tingling from the swing.
Oof, the handle slipped and I almost hit my own leg.
Give it another whack, I'm cheering for you the whole way.
You can do it! Swing from the hips and don't stop now.
Wow, you're fast with that thing. Teach me how you do it?
I got lucky, and I know it. Don't let that go to your head.
I'm shaking so bad I could drop this crowbar any second.
Okay, I'll be honest, I almost ran. Glad I didn't, though.
Haha, look at it twitch! It's gonna regret messing with us.
Give me a sec to stop shaking, then I'll swing again. Promise.
We're a good team, you and me. Let's keep it that way.
That zap hit it dead center. I felt the whole thing jolt.
Think it's out? Poke it with the axe handle, just to be sure.
Nah, that one barely flinched. Get ready, it's coming up.
Get behind me, I'll take the next swing. You watch the sides.
Stunned it! Yes! My wrist is going to hurt tomorrow, though.
Right in the knee. Honestly, that was my best swing yet.
I can't believe that worked. Keep it up, we're on a roll!
Hey, nice work on that lunge. You scared me in the best way.
The taser's still warm and I'm grinning like a fool right now.
I swung so hard I nearly fell over. Don't laugh at me!
Don't look at me like that, I was totally in control. Mostly.
That was close. I could still feel its breath on my neck.
It got one good hit on me. Ow. Still standing, though.
My ears are ringing from the crack. Worth it, though.
Come on, back up, back up. Let's not get grabbed today.
One more zap should finish it. Pretty sure, anyway.
I'm so proud of us right now. Seriously, we're kind of awesome.
Stop cheering, I'm still shaking! Give me a second, please.
Swing, miss, swing again. That's basically my whole plan today.
Ha, I hit it so hard the crowbar bounced back at me.
That was too easy. I feel like I should be scared of myself.
Let's grab the rest of the stuff while it's down, quick.
Good shot! You got it right in the sweet spot, friend.
My hands are slick, so I'll hang on to the handle tighter.
Okay, I'm calm now. Mostly. Let's go find the way out.
Honestly, I thought I was done for. Thanks for the save.
You saved my neck back there. Like, really saved it.
I think I just yelled something I'll be embarrassed about later.
Ugh, I bounced right off that wall. Let's not do that again.
Wait, did it stop moving? Poke it again, but from far away.
Keep your head down, I'll take the front. You take the back.
Haha, the look on its face when that hit. Priceless.
I'm shaking, but I'm happy. Weird combo, I know.
Next time I'm swinging first, just so you know.
My shoulder's sore, but I'll live. Let's keep moving.
That lunge almost had me. Thanks for shoving me out of the way.
Okay, hyped now. Let's smash the next one even harder!
